name: SSHI_FBR
rationale: The reference FBR fails on S2 and S4 due to diode voltage drops and low open-circuit voltage (Voc). A Parallel Synchronized Switch Harvesting on Inductor (SSHI) circuit is added to flip the voltage across the piezo capacitance Cp at the peaks. This effectively increases the voltage seen by the rectifier, boosting the average output voltage (vavg) and improving the startup time (tup) for weak excitation (S4) and heavy loads (S2). A Zener diode (DZ33) is included to clamp the output voltage and prevent overvoltage in S3.

name: SR_FBR
rationale: To eliminate the diode drops that cause failures in S2 and S4, this design replaces the diode bridge with a Synchronous Rectifier (SR). Using two SYNC controllers, it closes the appropriate switches for the positive and negative half-cycles of the piezo voltage. This minimizes power loss and ensures vavg stays above 1.8 V even for weak excitations. A Zener clamp is maintained for S3.
